chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated that 'Ibad ibn Suleiman narrated from Muhammad ibn Suleiman, from his father Suleiman al-Daylami, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar al-Sayrafi, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them) in a long narration in which he said:

O Ishaq! Indeed in the Hellfire there is a valley called Saqr, which has not breathed since God created it. And if God, the Exalted, ordered it to breathe even to the size of a needle's eye, it would burn everything on the face of the earth. And indeed the people of Hell seek refuge from the heat of that valley, its stench, its filth, and what God has prepared for its people. And indeed in that valley is a mountain, from whose heat, stench, filth, and what God has prepared for its people, all the people of that valley seek refuge. And indeed in that mountain is a valley, from whose heat, stench, filth, and what God has prepared for its people, all the people of that mountain seek refuge. And indeed in that valley is a well, from whose heat, stench, filth, and what God has prepared for its people, the people of that valley seek refuge. And indeed in that well is a snake, from whose foulness, stench, filth, and what God has prepared in its fangs as poison for its people, all the people of that well seek refuge. And indeed in the belly of that snake are seven chests containing five from the former nations and two from this nation.

I said: May I be your ransom, who are the five? And who are the two? He said: As for the five, they are Qabil who killed Habil, and Nimrod who argued with Ibrahim regarding his Lord, saying: I give life and cause death, and Pharaoh who said: I am your Lord, Most High, and Yahud who founded Judaism, and Paul who founded Christianity, and from this nation, two Arab Bedouins.

key_terms.بُولُس: Bulus (Paul, associated with the innovation of Christianity)
key_terms.سَقَر: Saqr (a specific valley or layer in Hell)
key_terms.نُمْرُود: Nimrod (the king who argued with Ibrahim)
key_terms.يَهُوذ: Yahud (associated with the innovation of Judaism)

ai.seo_question: Who are the five people from previous nations and the two from the current nation mentioned in the chests of Hell?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this nested cosmological structure to illustrate the intensifying severity of divine punishment, where each deeper layer serves as a relative refuge from the preceding torment. The identification of Yahud (likely Judah or a representative of the Jews) and Paul (representing Christians) among the five previous nations highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the spiritual deviations of earlier communities, while the inclusion of two Arab Bedouins underscores the universal applicability of these lessons to the contemporary Ummah.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-106 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted Ebad ibn Suleiman, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Suleiman, on the authority of his father Suleiman al-Daylami, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Am’mar al-Sayrafi, on the authority of Abil Hassan Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim (MGB) that in a long narration he (MGB) said,

“O Ishaq! Indeed there is a desert called Seqr in Hell. It has not breathed since the day in which God created it. Should the Honorable the Exalted God order it to breathe, it would burn everything that is on the Earth even if it breathes through a small hole the size of the head of a needle. The residents of Hell try to find protection against the burning; the bad scent; the evilness and the tortures of this area. There is a mountain in that desert in which those who want to find protection from its burning; bad scent; evilness and tortures go. There is a valley in that mountain in which those who want to find protection from its burning; bad scent; evilness and tortures go. There is a well in that valley in which those who want to find protection from its burning; bad scent; evilness and tortures go. There is a snake in that well to which those who want to find protection from its burning; bad scent; evilness and tortures go. There are seven cases in the belly of that snake which contain five people from the former nations and two of the people of this nation.”

Ishaq (ibn Am’mar al-Sayrafi) added, “I asked the Imam (MGB), ‘May I be your ransom! Who are those five people and who are the two from this nation?’ The Imam (MGB) replied, ‘The five people are Cain who killed Abel; Nimrood who argued with Abraham (MGB) regarding God and claimed that he was the one who gave life and death; Pharaoh who claimed ‘I am your Lord, Most High’ ; the Jew who innovated Judaism; Paul who innovated Christianity and the two people from this nation who are two Arab Bedouins.’”
